answer_1.quote: We introduce an instruction dataset tailored for the biomolecular domain and investigate how fine-tuned LLM performs on protein-domain instruction-following tasks, such as function description generation.
answer_1.outputs: function descriptions of proteins based on input prompts and demonstrations

answer_2.quote: To evaluate performances on multi-label classification tasks including EC and GO prediction, we report pair-centric area under precision-recall curve (AUPR) values and F max, a widely used metric in the CAFA challenges. PPI prediction results are evaluated by mean accuracy.
